<b>Groms</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are adult [[Gromling]]s that ceaselessly burrow through bone and rock in aligned groups.<ref>Grom [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Burrowing worm that uses its many blunted teeth to dig through even the hardest bone. They ceaselessly churn through rock and bone without ever seeming to rest."</i></ref><ref>[[Gromling]] Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Young masked worm that delights in ambushing intruders within its tunnels."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Groms are usually found in narrow passageways, constantly emerging from the ceiling and falling downwards before burrowing into the floor. They deal {{Damage|1}} on contact, but touching their mouths triggers a {{Damage|1+1}} combo.

Due to their speed, Groms can be difficult to defeat with the [[Needle]], so [[Tools]] and {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}} that deal high burst damage can be used instead. Additionally, the [[Sharpdart]] always kills them instantly.

== Location ==
Groms can be found throughout the [[Wormways]]. 

In [[Act 3]], the majority of them are killed by [[Lifeblood|Plasmium]], while several mutate into [[Plasmidas]]es. Only a few remain in the northeastern section of the area and in [[Weavenest Karn]].

==Trivia==
* Groms do not react to the [[Needolin]].
* [[wiktionary:grom|Grom]] is an Australian slang term for a young or amateur surfer.
* Groms have a unique animation when killed by the [[Sharpdart]].
